responsibility: Implements LoongArch psABI lowering for `FnAbi`, including floating-point aggregate eligibility analysis, XLEN/FLEN-based scalar and aggregate register classification, sign-extension behavior, varargs alignment rules, and tracking available integer and floating-point argument registers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/loongarch.rs`, this LoongArch file implements psABI call lowering with FP-eligible aggregate analysis, XLEN/FLEN-driven register assignment, varargs alignment, and register-budget tracking, rather than inline-asm register parsing and reservation checks.
